_readme: Gear Me Up data. Item names match case- and space-insensitively by 'contains'. Lists are best first. bosses.json is generated from this file plus the wiki research files by tools/convert.py.

bosses.name: Any monster (generic)
bosses.info: Best-in-slot by style from what you own. Pick the style your target is weakest to

setups.label: Melee (crush)
setups.notes: Weak to crush with -5 flat armour, so multi-hit weapons (scythe, dual macuahuitl, glacial temotli, Torag's hammers) shine. Weapon Freeze knocks your weapon into ice blocks you punch out (Soulreaper axe loses stacks). Requires Perilous Moons. No gear is provided: bring your own melee gear; the dungeon supplies food (cooked bream/moss lizard) and moonlight potions via supply crates. Wiki stresses tanky (Barrows/Torva/Justiciar) armour over strength-only armour; defence-reducing specs and Death Charge do nothing.

setups.label: Melee (stab)
setups.notes: Weak to stab with +6 flat armour (rapier beats scythe). During the Clone phase parries have 100% accuracy, so swap to a slow heavy hitter (Dharok's greataxe, Soulreaper axe, Elder maul). Requires Perilous Moons. No gear is provided: bring your own melee gear; the dungeon supplies food (cooked bream/moss lizard) and moonlight potions via supply crates. Wiki stresses tanky (Barrows/Torva/Justiciar) armour over strength-only armour; defence-reducing specs and Death Charge do nothing.

setups.label: Melee (slash)
setups.notes: Weak to slash, -2 flat armour. Heals whenever it damages you, so favour defence over pure strength. Kill blood jaguars to heal back. Requires Perilous Moons. No gear is provided: bring your own melee gear; the dungeon supplies food (cooked bream/moss lizard) and moonlight potions via supply crates. Wiki stresses tanky (Barrows/Torva/Justiciar) armour over strength-only armour; defence-reducing specs and Death Charge do nothing.

setups.label: Sol (melee slash)
setups.notes: Final wave (12) of the Fortis Colosseum, solo. No gear restrictions, but one inventory must cover all 12 waves. Don't mage or range Sol; dump Dragon claws/Burning claws below 10% HP; Saradomin godsword for healing.

setups.label: Waves (ranged)
setups.notes: The wiki's strongest first-quiver option is a Twisted bow setup; Bow of Faerdhinen + crystal armour is the budget route. Venator bow + dragon arrows for multi-target waves.

setups.label: Waves (magic)
setups.notes: A Shadow setup one-shots the melee Fremennik but has weak defence; a single trident/sang/Eye switch is enough to two-shot it.

setups.label: Melee (crush)
setups.notes: Dragonbane works (lance) and it is weakest to crush; Inquisitor's armour recommended. Defence drain is capped at 5 levels, so bring damage specs (Crimson kisten, Dragon claws). Multi-player world boss in Darkfrost.

setups.label: Tail phase
setups.notes: The tail has a per-hit damage cap, so multi-hit crush weapons speed it up a lot.

setups.label: Melee (crush)
setups.notes: Requires The Heart of Darkness. Weak to crush, -2 flat armour. Unstable ice can only be damaged by melee, so melee beats fire spells despite the 30% fire weakness. Thralls recommended; Slayer helmet (i) on a lesser nagua task.

setups.label: Melee (crush)
setups.notes: Slayer 92 and an araxyte/spider task required. Specs: Elder maul/Dragon warhammer, Crimson kisten, Dragon claws. A Noxious halberd one-hits white araxytes; bring venom protection.

setups.label: Ranged
setups.notes: Wiki: Twisted bow + Masori beats bludgeon-tier melee but is well behind the scythe. Araxyte switches: Hunters' sunlight crossbow, Karil's crossbow, Heavy ballista, Rune crossbow.

setups.label: Melee
setups.notes: Titans are primarily meleed (wiki prioritises melee strength); Slayer helmet (i) works on ice/fire giant tasks. A halberd lets you keep hitting from the Elemental Blast safespot.

setups.label: Ranged
setups.notes: For when the Titans are out of melee reach; their ranged defence is very high in parts of each phase.

setups.label: Magic (elementals/barriers)
setups.notes: Fire spells on Eldric's side, Water spells on Branda's. Needs 70+ magic attack bonus (39+ with void) to avoid splashing on minions, and 75 Magic to one-shot elementals with Fire/Water Wave. Twinflame staff auto-swaps fire/water.

setups.label: Melee
setups.notes: Titans are primarily meleed (wiki prioritises melee strength); Slayer helmet (i) works on ice/fire giant tasks. A halberd lets you keep hitting from the Elemental Blast safespot.

setups.label: Ranged
setups.notes: For when the Titans are out of melee reach; their ranged defence is very high in parts of each phase.

setups.label: Magic (elementals/barriers)
setups.notes: Fire spells on Eldric's side, Water spells on Branda's. Needs 70+ magic attack bonus (39+ with void) to avoid splashing on minions, and 75 Magic to one-shot elementals with Fire/Water Wave. Twinflame staff auto-swaps fire/water.

setups.label: Melee (slash)
setups.notes: Requires A Kingdom Divided; solo or duo. Weak to slash, with 120% demonbane vulnerability (Emberlight +84%). Duos: Elder maul/Dragon warhammer + Soulflame horn. Solo melee still needs a Purging staff (+Occult/Tormented) for void flares.

setups.label: Magic
setups.notes: Only recommended with Tumeken's shadow and/or a Purging staff (flares). Magic defence rises to +60 while the target uses magic. Noxious halberd or Twisted bow as a Judge of Yama switch.

setups.label: Ranged
setups.notes: Requires The Final Dawn. Ranged recommended (Magic level 275 favours the Twisted bow); elite void matches Masori with a Scorching bow and is much cheaper to reclaim. Zaryte crossbow spec is key; defence drain is capped at 60 and resets each delve; Lightbearer strongly advised.

setups.label: Melee punish
setups.notes: Doom is technically weakest to crush but melee as a main style is inadvisable. Bring a multi-hit/halberd switch for the melee-punish window (Crystal halberd spec is the budget pick).

setups.label: Larvae (demonbane melee)
setups.notes: You need a one-way swap per style for demonic larvae; Darklight is the cheapest demonbane melee option.

setups.label: Larvae (magic)
setups.notes: Autocast Superior Demonbane (Arceuus) with a Slayer's staff or Skull sceptre. Thralls not recommended (they spread acid); Death Charge is strong.

setups.label: Melee
setups.notes: Low-level world boss in the Varrock Sewers (combat 200 solo / 250 group). Ratbane weapons (Bone mace/shortbow/staff) are strong at mid level; mid-level alternatives: Zombie axe, Sarachnis cudgel, Dragon scimitar.

setups.label: Ranged
setups.notes: Mid-level option: Void ranger with a Bone shortbow.

setups.label: Magic
setups.notes: Mid-level: Bloodbark/Elder chaos robes with a Bone staff.

setups.label: Melee (free-to-play)
setups.notes: F2P boss after The Ides of Milk (Lumbridge cow field). Crush-defence armour (chainbody) helps; the cowbell amulet speeds up respawns.

setups.label: Magic (free-to-play)
setups.notes: Often outperforms melee at low levels; earth spells hit its 25% earth weakness.

setups.label: Ranged (free-to-play)
setups.notes: Green d'hide setup.

setups.label: Melee (members)
setups.notes: Members high-level setup from the wiki.

setups.label: Melee (slash)
setups.notes: Requires Desert Treasure II; feed Brutus an abyssal potato from the Scar. Specials always hit if not dodged, so Elite void + Void melee helm is a fine cheaper setup.

setups.label: Melee
setups.notes: Requires Troubled Tortugans and a gryphon Slayer task (or an elite clue). Knockback affects players under 40 kg worn weight, so wear heavy armour + Tortugan shield / Dragonfire shield.

setups.label: Ranged (flying)
setups.notes: While levitating only halberds can reach it with melee; weakest to crush and heavy ranged. Immune to Ancient Magicks; 80% fire weakness. Raid (2-8 players, released 20 Oct 2026), requires While Guthix Sleeps. Wiki raid-wide switches: Inquisitor's melee, Masori ranged, Ancestral magic; defence-drain specs (Elder maul, Dragon warhammer, Tonalztics of Ralos) are central.

setups.label: Melee (grounded)
setups.notes: Crush it when grounded. Defence 260 drains to 156 (4 Tonalztics specs).

setups.label: Melee (crush)
setups.notes: Heavily defensive vs stab/ranged/magic; use slash or crush. Two DWH/Elder maul specs reach the defence cap. Enrage specs: Zaryte crossbow, Crimson kisten, Dragon claws. Raid (2-8 players, released 20 Oct 2026), requires While Guthix Sleeps. Wiki raid-wide switches: Inquisitor's melee, Masori ranged, Ancestral magic; defence-drain specs (Elder maul, Dragon warhammer, Tonalztics of Ralos) are central.

setups.label: Melee (crush)
setups.notes: Bork has 8 flat armour (rising to 14 as the Smorks take damage), so big hits beat multi-hits. Fought alongside the Smorks (def 220, drainable to 0). Raid (2-8 players, released 20 Oct 2026), requires While Guthix Sleeps. Wiki raid-wide switches: Inquisitor's melee, Masori ranged, Ancestral magic; defence-drain specs (Elder maul, Dragon warhammer, Tonalztics of Ralos) are central.

setups.label: Ranged
setups.notes: Very low heavy ranged defence (+5); also good on the Smorks.

setups.label: Ranged
setups.notes: Most vulnerable to light ranged early; 80% air weakness. Raid (2-8 players, released 20 Oct 2026), requires While Guthix Sleeps. Wiki raid-wide switches: Inquisitor's melee, Masori ranged, Ancestral magic; defence-drain specs (Elder maul, Dragon warhammer, Tonalztics of Ralos) are central.

setups.label: Melee (enrage)
setups.notes: Weak to stab and crush, but melee is only usable in the enrage phase.

setups.label: Ranged
setups.notes: Moves slowly but hits up to 30 through Protect from Melee if it reaches you: bind it with Scorching bow specs or freeze it with ice spells (40% freeze resistance). Only 25% demonbane vulnerability. Raid (2-8 players, released 20 Oct 2026), requires While Guthix Sleeps. Wiki raid-wide switches: Inquisitor's melee, Masori ranged, Ancestral magic; defence-drain specs (Elder maul, Dragon warhammer, Tonalztics of Ralos) are central.

setups.label: Melee
setups.notes: Defence drains to 0 in the enrage phase.

setups.label: Ranged
setups.notes: The Elder plus two monks share a static shield; destabilise the ritual cauldron. Defence 100 drains to 0 with three Tonalztics specs (per target). Raid (2-8 players, released 20 Oct 2026), requires While Guthix Sleeps. Wiki raid-wide switches: Inquisitor's melee, Masori ranged, Ancestral magic; defence-drain specs (Elder maul, Dragon warhammer, Tonalztics of Ralos) are central.

setups.label: Melee (crush)
setups.notes: Weakest to crush and light ranged; only 80% demonbane vulnerability. Burn stacks raise damage taken; his phase 1 magic hits through prayer. Raid (2-8 players, released 20 Oct 2026), requires While Guthix Sleeps. Wiki raid-wide switches: Inquisitor's melee, Masori ranged, Ancestral magic; defence-drain specs (Elder maul, Dragon warhammer, Tonalztics of Ralos) are central.

setups.label: Ranged
setups.notes: 85% water weakness for magic users.

setups.label: Melee (phase 3/4)
setups.notes: Final raid boss, 4 phases; extremely weak to crush in the close-quarters final phases. Stat drains reset each phase; do Elder maul specs at the Bandosian Censer first. Raid (2-8 players, released 20 Oct 2026), requires While Guthix Sleeps. Wiki raid-wide switches: Inquisitor's melee, Masori ranged, Ancestral magic; defence-drain specs (Elder maul, Dragon warhammer, Tonalztics of Ralos) are central.

setups.label: Ranged (phase 1/2, untethered)
setups.notes: Phase 1 is weakest to light/heavy ranged (+50); phase 2 is fought with ranged.

setups.label: Melee (solo)
setups.notes: Needs 70 Strength (cannot be boosted) for Bandos' Stronghold. Wear a ranged-defence body (Masori body (f) or Karil's) unless using Justiciar/Torva; the wiki's special-attack weapons are Voidwaker, Saradomin godsword, Dragon claws and Elder maul.

setups.label: Ranged (solo)
setups.notes: The wiki calls ranged the most straightforward solo style: you can kite and avoid all of Graardor's damage. Wear crystal armour only with the Bow of Faerdhinen.

setups.label: Magic
setups.notes: Freeze with Ice Barrage (an Ice ancient sceptre is ideal) and attack from range. Tome of Earth only helps with earth spells (40% earth weakness).

setups.label: Ranged
setups.notes: Needs 70 Agility (cannot be boosted) and ropes. Kite her around the room with Protect from Magic on; a Toxic blowpipe or Serpentine helm switch helps envenom the bodyguards.

setups.label: Magic
setups.notes: Use Protect from Missiles, with Blood Barrage on the bodyguards and the Eldritch Nightmare staff special for sustain. The wiki says this needs near-max magic gear; otherwise use ranged.

setups.label: Ranged
setups.notes: Needs 70 Ranged to enter the Eyrie (grapple), plus 40 Armadyl killcount or an Ecumenical key. Attack off-tick so he doesn't melee; Black or Red chinchompas work for clearing the room.

setups.label: Magic
setups.notes: The wiki's magic setup uses Tumeken's shadow in max magic gear. Air spells get the 30% weakness.

setups.label: Melee
setups.notes: Needs 70 Hitpoints to enter. Wear armour with high magic defence (Masori or d'hide); his prayer smash hits through prayer and a Spectral spirit shield reduces it. Demonbane weapons (Emberlight, Arclight) are best.

setups.label: Ranged
setups.notes: The Scorching bow is demonbane and ranked first on the wiki.

setups.label: Magic
setups.notes: Water spells get the 30% weakness.

setups.label: Ranged
setups.notes: Needs The Frozen Door miniquest. Team boss; the wiki strongly advises against soloing. Ruby-bolt specs with the Zaryte crossbow are standard, and five Zarosian items (Ancient d'hide) give extra essence for killcount.

setups.label: Melee hybrid
setups.notes: Melee damage with ranged switches for the Shadow and Zaros phases. The wiki ranks Osmumten's fang next to Inquisitor's mace only when wearing at least two Inquisitor pieces.

setups.label: Ranged
setups.notes: Level 39 multi-combat Wilderness; needs the Wilderness Medium Diary. You risk your items, so bring only 3-4 valuable items or wilderness weapons; freeze him (Ice Barrage or Entangle) and keep him away from you, because his melee hits through prayer.

setups.label: Magic
setups.notes: No longer immune to magic, but he has a high Magic level. Use Accursed sceptre specials for a bind and defence drain.

setups.label: Ranged
setups.notes: Singles-plus mid-level Wilderness; needs the Wilderness Hard Diary. You risk your items, so use wilderness weapons or a 3-4 item setup; freeze her with ice spells.

setups.label: Magic
setups.notes: Ice spells almost always hit her and bind her. At 66% and 33% health she breaks free and lays bear traps.

setups.label: Melee (crush)
setups.notes: Multi-combat deep Wilderness; needs the Wilderness Medium Diary. You risk your items, so use chainmace or 3-item setups and protect untradeables with a Trouver parchment. At 50% health, kill the hellhounds, which make him immune while alive.

setups.label: Melee (crush)
setups.notes: Level 21 singles-plus Wilderness; needs the Wilderness Hard Diary. You risk your items, so protect untradeables with a Trouver parchment. All his attacks are area attacks you can dodge; kill the hellhounds at 50%.

setups.label: Melee (crush)
setups.notes: Multi-combat deep Wilderness; needs the Wilderness Medium Diary. You risk your items, so use wilderness weapons or 3-4 items. In melee distance she only melees; avoid the webs, which drain run energy.

setups.label: Ranged
setups.notes: Switch overheads with her cycle of 8 ranged then 8 magic attacks. Ranged lets you stay near the exit.

setups.label: Melee (crush)
setups.notes: Level 29 Wilderness; needs the Wilderness Hard Diary. You risk your items, so use wilderness weapons; avoid the webs.

setups.label: Ranged
setups.notes: Switch overheads with her attack cycle.

setups.label: Ranged
setups.notes: Level 50 Wilderness; you risk your items. Keep your inventory full (curry, pies or Guthix rest) to stop Madness unequipping you. A safespot exists near the Resource Area.

setups.label: Melee
setups.notes: Flinching behind a tree is the wiki's safest solo method; attack speed doesn't matter when flinching.

setups.label: Ranged
setups.notes: Wilderness PK hotspot; you risk your items. Use inventory-blocking food (summer pies, curry, Armadyl brews) because he can unequip your gear.

setups.label: Magic
setups.notes: Level 22-25 Wilderness; you risk your items, so take 3-4 valuables at most. Step out of the 'Rain of knowledge!' book area; his low Magic level makes magic accuracy matter little, so prayer gear (monk robes) is fine.

setups.label: Magic
setups.notes: Level 50+ multi-combat Wilderness; you risk your items, so take 3-4 valuables. Freeze her with Ice Barrage or Entangle; kill or lure away the healing guardians below 99 HP; bring antipoison.

setups.label: Melee
setups.notes: The lair isn't in the Wilderness, but reaching it crosses level 42 Wilderness, so you risk your items. Use an anti-dragon shield or Dragonfire shield, or a defender only with an Extended super antifire plus Protect from Magic. The wiki's special-attack weapons are Voidwaker, Burning claws and Arkan blade.

setups.label: Ranged
setups.notes: Use Dragonfire protection: a Dragonfire ward or Anti-dragon shield, or an Extended super antifire if the weapon is two-handed.

setups.label: Ranged
setups.notes: Random demi-boss in the Revenant Caves (Wilderness), functionally multi-combat. You risk your items, and Protect from Missiles leaves you open to a teleblock. Dodge its ice and blood spells by moving; the top damager wearing an Amulet of avarice gets Forinthry Surge.

setups.label: Magic
setups.notes: Its lowest defence is magic (101). Setups are taken from the Revenants/Strategies page.

setups.label: Melee (Phase 2/3)
setups.notes: Phase 1 needs a Shadow spell (Ancient Magicks, e.g. Shadow Barrage) to disorient the Sire; Emberlight on stab (slash with Oathplate). Demonbane weapons are strong.

setups.label: Magic
setups.notes: Bring an ancient sceptre/Ancient Magicks for the Shadow spell disorient in phase 1.

setups.label: Ranged
setups.notes: Scorching bow is demonbane; still needs a Shadow spell to disorient in phase 1.

setups.label: Ranged
setups.notes: Only on hydra task (Konar/Mortimer). Boots of stone/brimstone/granite boots needed in Karuulm unless elite Kourend & Kebos Diary is done. Lure into vents to remove damage-reduction buff.

setups.label: Melee
setups.notes: Low stab defence (75); Dragon hunter lance on stab.

setups.label: Melee
setups.notes: Low crush defence. Spectral spirit shield halves the Grey ghost prayer drain. Cannon not allowed.

setups.label: Ranged
setups.notes: Only on hellhound/Cerberus task.

setups.label: Melee
setups.notes: Dusk is immune to magic and ranged. Requires gargoyle/guardian task and a one-time brittle key to unlock the roof.

setups.label: Ranged
setups.notes: Normally used as a ranged switch while in melee gear for Dusk. Dawn is flying, so only halberds can reach her in melee.

setups.label: Magic
setups.notes: Only on cave kraken/Kraken task (also needs 50 Magic). Ranged deals 1/7 damage, melee cannot reach it. Its magic attack has 100% prayer penetration. Cannon not allowed.

setups.label: Melee
setups.notes: Very low melee defence. Smoke Devil Dungeon requires a slayer helmet/facemask/gas mask; only on smoke devil task (one diary kill excepted).

setups.label: Magic
setups.notes: The wiki lists magic first despite the +800 magic defence (Thermy has a low Magic level). Its attacks have 100% prayer penetration. Cannon not allowed.

setups.label: Melee
setups.notes: Needs a dark totem (Catacombs of Kourend). Arclight/Emberlight disable an altar in one hit and lessen the altar damage reduction. Immune to recoil.

setups.label: Ranged
setups.notes: Not task-only; slayer helmet only helps on task. Kill the awakened altars first.

setups.label: Ranged
setups.notes: Requires Dragon Slayer II. Use a dragonfire shield plus extended super antifire, and bring anti-venom.

setups.label: Melee
setups.notes: Super antifire is needed (no shield slot for an anti-dragon shield with a defender). Very low stab defence.

setups.label: Magic
setups.notes: Use against green (serpentine) and red (magma) forms. Bring anti-venom.

setups.label: Ranged
setups.notes: Use against blue (tanzanite) form, which has 0 ranged defence and 300 magic defence. Melee only reaches with halberds (Noxious halberd + Eclipse atlatl setup on the wiki).

setups.label: Melee (stab)
setups.notes: 50% damage reduction against everything except corpbane weapons (spears, halberds, Osmumten's fang) used on stab. Drain defence first with Elder maul/Dragon warhammer, Bandos godsword or Arclight specs.

setups.label: Magic
setups.notes: Rex is weak only to magic. Safespots exist (wiki has a Rex safespot inventory). Multicombat with the other kings.

setups.label: Ranged
setups.notes: Prime is weak only to ranged.

setups.label: Melee
setups.notes: Supreme is weak only to melee (all melee defences 10).

setups.label: Melee
setups.notes: Keris partisans are kalphite-bane. Phase 1 (crawling) has low crush defence; phase 2 has low magic/ranged defence (10). Slayer helmet only works on kalphite task.

setups.label: Ranged
setups.notes: Best in phase 2 (airborne).

setups.label: Magic
setups.notes: Labelled 'Max Mage (0 switches)' on the wiki; good for phase 2.

setups.label: Ranged
setups.notes: Bring a light source (Falador Hard Diary helps track the mole).

setups.label: Magic
setups.notes: 50% earth weakness, so earth spells are good.

setups.label: Melee
setups.notes: Lowest melee defence is stab (60). The wiki also lists a Dharok's setup.

setups.label: Melee
setups.notes: Very low crush defence. Kill the spawns.

setups.label: Magic
setups.notes: The wiki lists only Tumeken's shadow, with a melee special attack switch.

setups.label: Ranged
setups.notes: Barrows brother with 0 ranged defence.

setups.label: Magic
setups.notes: Wind spells (air weakness 50%). Ghommal's hilt 2 removes the Barrows prayer drain.

setups.label: Magic
setups.notes: Use wind spells.

setups.label: Magic
setups.notes: Use wind spells.

setups.label: Magic
setups.notes: Use wind spells.

setups.label: Magic
setups.notes: Use wind spells.

setups.label: Melee
setups.notes: Very low crush defence. Specs: Elder maul / Saradomin godsword / Crimson kisten. Cannon not allowed.

setups.label: Magic
setups.notes: Mainly used for killing totems, not the boss itself.

setups.label: Melee
setups.notes: Solo-only Nightmare variant. Hallowfell can kill husks/parasites; Crimson kisten spec. Turn off overheads before husks spawn if not using Hallowfell.

setups.label: Magic
setups.notes: For totems. Zorya's tome is used as a spec.

setups.label: Magic
setups.notes: F2P boss behind a giant key gate. Snare/Entangle/Ice spells to bind him.

setups.label: Ranged
setups.notes: Members should use the Toxic blowpipe; F2P should wear a rune chainbody with 60 Ranged.

setups.label: Melee
setups.notes: Faster but riskier; knock-backs delay attacks.

setups.label: Magic
setups.notes: F2P: Fire Blast with Protect from Magic is the highest DPS (50% fire weakness). Growthlings must be killed with an axe or secateurs (the boss is immune while they live).

setups.label: Ranged
setups.notes: Keep distance; she won't follow.

setups.label: Melee
setups.notes: Members burst her with special attacks. Bring an axe (not a battleaxe or zombie axe) for growthlings.

setups.label: Melee
setups.notes: Farming Guild boss (65 Farming). Low slash defence. Kill the flowers to stop the entangle; immune to recoil.

setups.label: Magic
setups.notes: 100% fire weakness, so cast fire spells.

setups.label: Magic
setups.notes: On Fossil Island (Bone Voyage). The wiki's only gear table is magic, for an avoidance strategy.

setups.label: Magic
setups.notes: Started from a mimic casket (elite/master clues). Dodge the candy. Ice spells can freeze it.

setups.label: Ranged
setups.notes: Voidwaker is the suggested spec.

setups.label: Melee
setups.notes: Weakest option: high melee defence.

setups.label: Melee
setups.notes: Requires Desert Treasure II. Very low slash defence; demonbane (Emberlight/Arclight) is viable. Specs: Dragon claws/Burning claws, Voidwaker, Bandos godsword. Awakened version (combat 1099) needs an awakener's orb.

setups.label: Ranged
setups.notes: Heavy ranged defence is lowest (25), so crossbows top the list. Dodge falling rocks; specs Zaryte crossbow / Webweaver bow.

setups.label: Magic (lightning phase)
setups.notes: The wiki lists a Shadow-based magic setup. Zorya's tome, Volatile Nightmare staff and Accursed sceptre are spec options.

setups.label: Melee
setups.notes: Requires DT2. Slash attacks only, so keep Protect from Melee up. Slash defence and tank gear (Justiciar, blood fury) both matter. Specs: Dragon claws/Burning claws, Voidwaker, Ancient godsword. Awakened is combat 1136.

setups.label: Magic
setups.notes: 60% earth weakness, so earth spells with Tome of earth and Elemental amulet are strong. In the shadow realm, bring a fast weapon for Lost Souls (Venator bow, Blisterwood stake, blowpipe). Specs: Zorya's tome, Eldritch Nightmare staff, Accursed sceptre. Awakened is combat 1146.

setups.label: Ranged
setups.notes: Main damage style while Muspah is in its ranged/magic form (ranged defence 56). Requires Secrets of the North. Specs: Zaryte crossbow, Elder maul/Dragon warhammer.

setups.label: Melee (melee form)
setups.notes: The melee form has magic defence 34 and ranged defence 261. Most players switch to magic here; melee is an alternative.

setups.label: Magic (melee form / shield)
setups.notes: Use against the melee form. Air spells exploit the 65% weakness.

setups.label: Ranged
setups.notes: This is the wiki's main Fight Caves setup. Kill the healers. Bring prayer potions and Saradomin brews.

setups.label: Melee
setups.notes: Alternative setup. Waves are harder without range; lure Jad to melee distance.

setups.label: Magic
setups.notes: Water spells exploit the 40% weakness. The wiki also lists Pure, early-iron and Eclipse atlatl setups.

setups.label: Ranged (first cape)
setups.notes: The wiki's Inferno setups are hybrid ranged/magic: a Kodai wand, Nightmare staff or ancient sceptre for barrages plus a ranged weapon. A Twisted bow is best on Zuk, then the Bow of Faerdhinen. Zuk's hits cannot be prayed against, so stay behind the shield.

setups.label: Mage tank
setups.notes: High-end option that swaps tank armour pieces in. The wiki recommends a Tumeken's shadow for magers, Jads and Zuk.

setups.label: Melee
setups.notes: Specs: Bandos godsword, Elder maul or Dragon warhammer on Tekton/Olm; Dragon claws or Voidwaker. Dragon hunter lance applies on Olm (dragon).

setups.label: Ranged
setups.notes: The Twisted bow is best in slot, especially on Olm's head. Specs: Zaryte crossbow, Tonalztics of Ralos.

setups.label: Magic
setups.notes: Use for Olm's mage hand, Vespula, melee Vanguard and baby Muttadile. Bring a pickaxe (Crystal, Infernal or Dragon) for Guardians.

setups.label: Melee
setups.notes: The Scythe of Vitur is the core weapon in every room. Specs: Dragon claws, Elder maul, Bandos godsword, Crystal halberd, Dragon warhammer. Void is common, swapping only the helm between styles.

setups.label: Ranged
setups.notes: A switch for Maiden, Nylocas, Xarpus and Verzik P2/P3 ranged. The ranged switch is often just the Void ranger helm.

setups.label: Magic
setups.notes: Used for barraging at Maiden and Nylocas and for magic Nylos. The Sanguinesti staff is a key heal source. Pick up the Dawnbringer for Verzik P1.

setups.label: Melee
setups.notes: Osmumten's fang (stab) is the main ToA melee weapon. Specs: Voidwaker, Bandos godsword, Elder maul, Soulflame horn, Burning claws, Dragon warhammer.

setups.label: Ranged
setups.notes: Specs: Zaryte crossbow, Bandos godsword, Toxic blowpipe.

setups.label: Magic
setups.notes: Tumeken's shadow is the key weapon (Akkha, obelisk, Wardens). Salve amulets do nothing on Ba-Ba.

setups.label: Ranged (head)
setups.notes: The head has 50 ranged defence; dragonbane weapons apply.

setups.label: Melee (left claw)
setups.notes: The left (melee) claw has 50 stab, slash and crush defence.

setups.label: Magic (right claw)
setups.notes: The right (mage) claw has 50 magic defence. Earth Surge with Tome of earth exploits the 50% earth weakness.

setups.label: Melee
setups.notes: In P1, use the Dawnbringer special attack. In P3, melee is preferred because slash defence is 30.

setups.label: Ranged
setups.notes: Used in P2 and on Nylocas.

setups.label: Magic
setups.notes: Used on magic Nylocas and for P2 healing. The infobox lists a 50% fire weakness in P3.

setups.label: Magic
setups.notes: P1 obelisk and P3/P4. In P2 the charged Warden is magic defence -30. Tumeken's Warden prays melee and magic, so ranged is needed first.

setups.label: Ranged
setups.notes: Use when Tumeken's Warden is praying melee and magic, and in P3/P4. Specs: Zaryte crossbow, Zorya's tome, Tonalztics of Ralos, Accursed sceptre.

setups.label: Melee (core)
setups.notes: Hit the ejected core in P2 with fast melee specs.

setups.label: Magic
setups.notes: Akkha prays against the style he is attacking with and changes style every six attacks plus a special. His magic defence is 10.

setups.label: Melee
setups.notes: The fang is listed on the wiki's Akkha weapon table.

setups.label: Ranged
setups.notes: Ranged defence is lowest, and the Twisted bow is best. Stay out of melee range to avoid bleed. Immune to life leech.

setups.label: Magic
setups.notes: The Shadow is second on the wiki's weapon list.

setups.label: Melee
setups.notes: Stab defence is 60. Keris partisans get a bonus against kalphites. Dodge fireball shadows and kill the shield scarabs.

setups.label: Melee
setups.notes: Stab defence is 80. Protect from Melee fully blocks her melee. Stand next to debris to avoid thrown rocks.

setups.label: Ranged
setups.notes: Heavy ranged defence (120) is lower than light/standard, so crossbows are preferred.

setups.label: Melee
setups.notes: Demonbane weapons are best. When the shield is down, hit hard with crush (Dharok's greataxe, Tzhaar-ket-om, Dragon 2h sword, Granite maul, Saradomin godsword). Requires While Guthix Sleeps.

setups.label: Ranged
setups.notes: When the shield is down, use a heavy ranged weapon on Accurate: Heavy ballista, Light ballista, Zaryte crossbow, Armadyl crossbow.

setups.label: Magic
setups.notes: Use demonbane spells (Purging staff, Mark of Darkness). Twinflame staff is recommended for the shield-down hit.
